methods.title: Methods and assumptions
methods.intro: How ITZA computes what it shows. Each section lists the formulas and the assumptions behind them.
methods.fao56.title: FAO-56 reference and crop water use
methods.fao56.assumption0: Daily weather comes from NASA POWER (temperature, humidity, wind, solar radiation).
methods.fao56.assumption1: Soil heat flux G is treated as zero at a daily step.
methods.fao56.assumption2: Kc follows the four FAO-56 growth stages; fallow uses a soil evaporation coefficient.
methods.waterBalance.title: Water balance
methods.waterBalance.formula:
Dr,i = Dr,i−1 − (P − RO) + ETc,adj + DP
Ks = 1 if Dr ≤ RAW, else (TAW − Dr) / ((1 − p)·TAW)
methods.waterBalance.assumption0: Runoff uses a simplified curve-number method by soil group and cover.
methods.waterBalance.assumption1: Water above field capacity drains away.
methods.waterBalance.assumption2: Root depth grows with crop stage.
methods.waterBalance.assumption3: Irrigation is not modeled or prescribed.
methods.scoring.title: Scoring and resilience
methods.scoring.formula:
Score(R, year) = Σ weight_k × criterion_k(R, year), weights sum to 1
Win rate = share of seasons where the rotation beats the baseline
methods.scoring.assumption0: Criteria are scaled from 0 to 1: climate fit, water balance, soil nitrogen, organic matter, erosion control, bare-field exposure, pest pressure and forage or income.
methods.scoring.assumption1: Weights come from your priority sliders.
methods.scoring.assumption2: Rankings are relative comparisons, not yield forecasts.
methods.monteCarlo.title: Monte Carlo uncertainty
methods.monteCarlo.formula: 200 seeded draws over Kc (±10%), soil water capacity (±20%), sowing date (±10 days) and depletion fraction (±0.1)
methods.monteCarlo.assumption0: The same seed always gives the same bands.
methods.monteCarlo.assumption1: Bands show how much the ranking depends on uncertain inputs.
methods.deltaChange.title: 2050 delta-change
methods.deltaChange.formula:
Future day = observed day + ΔT (temperature)
Future rain = observed rain × ratio (precipitation, capped)
methods.deltaChange.assumption0: Monthly factors compare 2041–2060 with 1995–2014 in NASA NEX-GDDP climate models, per emissions scenario.
methods.deltaChange.assumption1: Factors are applied to the observed 2001–2025 daily record, giving 25 plausible future seasons.
methods.deltaChange.assumption2: Future seasons are plausible, not predicted.
methods.fieldMemory.title: Field Memory
methods.fieldMemory.formula: Greenness series → smooth → find green-up, peak and senescence → label each season
methods.fieldMemory.assumption0: Satellite greenness comes from HLS (30 m) where available and MODIS (250 m) otherwise.
methods.fieldMemory.assumption1: Labels are inferred from timing and size of the greenness peak; your confirmation overrides them.
methods.fieldMemory.assumption2: Satellite estimates differ from ground measurements; soil tests and field observations take precedence.
